description: No extra.transactionVersions: the accepted set is [0], so the client builds a version-0 open (never legacy). The client builds and signs the channel open from the challenge hints (no live RPC); the judge runs the Rust upto verifier on the SDK's header and compares the open with the kit's own build modulo the salt.

spec.quote: The client MUST intersect the advertised versions ([0] when the field is absent) with the versions it and its signer support, then build the highest version in that intersection.

description: extra.transactionVersions [0, 1] and a signer that signs version 1: the client builds the highest version, a version-1 open whose compute budget rides in the message config (no ComputeBudget instructions). The client builds and signs the channel open from the challenge hints (no live RPC); the judge runs the Rust upto verifier on the SDK's header and compares the open with the kit's own build modulo the salt.

spec.quote: The client MUST intersect the advertised versions ([0] when the field is absent) with the versions it and its signer support, then build the highest version in that intersection.

description: extra.transactionVersions [0, 1] but the signer signs up to version 0: the intersection is [0], a version-0 open. The client builds and signs the channel open from the challenge hints (no live RPC); the judge runs the Rust upto verifier on the SDK's header and compares the open with the kit's own build modulo the salt.

spec.quote: The client MUST intersect the advertised versions ([0] when the field is absent) with the versions it and its signer support, then build the highest version in that intersection.

description: extra.transactionVersions [1] and a signer that signs up to version 0: no version is buildable, the client fails with unsupported_transaction_version. The client builds and signs the channel open from the challenge hints (no live RPC); the judge runs the Rust upto verifier on the SDK's header and compares the open with the kit's own build modulo the salt.

spec.quote: It MUST fail with unsupported_transaction_version when the intersection is empty.

description: The server accepts [0, 1]: a version-1 open (header compute budget 200000 units, 1 lamport priority fee, the maximum loaded-data limit; no ComputeBudget prefix) passes the same policy. Verify is the read-only preflight of the deposit settle (Phase 3): every static check before co-signing, at the vector's clock (nowSeconds).

spec.quote: The message version MUST be one advertised in extra.transactionVersions (0 when the field is absent; see [Transaction versions](#transaction-versions)), and the message MUST NOT contain Address Lookup Table lookups.

spec.quote: The facilitator MUST reject a message whose version is outside the set it accepts, before inspecting any instruction, with unsupported_transaction_version.

description: A version-1 open whose header computeUnitLimit is 400001: rejected as compute-limit-over-cap. Verify is the read-only preflight of the deposit settle (Phase 3): every static check before co-signing, at the vector's clock (nowSeconds).
